feature_definition: Append eight recorded-event memory measurements to every unchanged eligible baseline row. Ten-second windows include their left endpoint, exclude the current event, and stop at explicit boundaries; unknown events or ownership invalidate count completeness. Last same-team attempt survives only intervening recognized live events. Observed strength-spell age is time since first equal state observation, not adjudicated penalty age or a true transition time.
fit: Unchanged fixed HGB architecture and original chronological train/calibration/validation windows. Train-only medians and categories; preserve missing indicators. No rows filtered or hyperparameters tuned. Calibrate new raw predictions using the unchanged sigmoid and monotone_logit_group algorithms on the original calibration period only.
evaluation: Keep frozen neutral, new raw, new sigmoid and new monotone-group probabilities on exactly the same outcomes and original subgroups/bins. Primary must be no worse on BOTH Brier and log loss in EACH development fold versus frozen neutral; no automatic acceptance or fallback winner selection.
source_audit: Fresh original source replay; preserve exact old raw and calibrated inference; verify source current-goal/outcome changes cannot alter same-event new features, and truncated prefix reproduces same-event features. Save all appended feature vectors and per-season availability.
limitations: Inspected development seasons, not untouched test or historical-as-of proof.
Bundled event-history ablation does not establish individual feature-family value.
Recorded-event counts and displacement are not possession, passes, goalie tracking, shifts or power-play reconstruction.
Game bootstrap intervals hold fits fixed and omit adaptive-selection and model-refit uncertainty.
All original artifacts, actuals and prospective reservations remain unchanged. No MoneyPuck data or predictions are used.
